raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Program & Project Management • Business Transformation • Program Governance • Operations Leadership • Governance, Risk Management & Compliance (SOX / PwC / KYC / AML / Sanctions) • Business Contingency Planning & Control Monitoring • Stakeholder & Vendor Management • Change & Agile Management • Analytics-Enabled Transformation (Power BI, SQL, Python) • Automation & Workflow Digitization (RPA, OCR) • People & Performance Management • Capacity & Demand Planning • RAID / Action Tracking • Multi-Country, Multi-Site Delivery • Continuous Improvement (Lean, Six Sigma)
TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES
JIRA | Clarity | Power BI | SQL | Python | Excel | PowerPoint | Visio | RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism) | OCR | Governance Trackers | RAID Logs | MI Dashboards
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Independent Consultant — Business Transformation Independent transformation practice focused on formalizing project management expertise and building applied data/analytics capability — extending a decade of HSBC transformation leadership into structured, technology-enabled program delivery.
Jun 2024 – Present
Completed PMP® certification (PMI, 2026), formalizing structured program delivery, governance, and stakeholder alignment practices built over a decade of transformation leadership.
Completed a PG Diploma in Data Science & Machine Learning with AI, including a project-based internship with Flip Robo Technologies (Jul–Dec 2024), to lead technology- and automation-enabled transformation with greater depth and credibility.
Applied prior HSBC transformation experience — process re-engineering, automation opportunity identification, and program governance — to self-directed case work and skill-building exercises.
Built additional depth in Agile and hybrid delivery models, risk management, and transformation execution frameworks.
HSBC Electronic Data Processing India Pvt. Ltd. — Program Manager, Business TransformationSep 2013 – May 2024 (10 yrs 9 mos) • Led business transformation and program governance across HSBC’s global Lending Services (Mortgages & Cards), spanning multi-
country operations across Canada, UK, and Bermuda.
Owned end-to-end delivery across 2 business entities (Canada Mortgages, Bermuda Cards), 3 delivery sites (Hyderabad, Kolkata, Manila) and 8 processes including French Mortgages — driving governance cadence, RAID/action tracking, and escalation management.
Led change and agile management workstreams during HSBC Canada’s business transition to RBC (Royal Bank of Canada), delivering full business continuity with zero service disruption.
Delivered productivity savings equivalent to 15+ FTEs through automation, RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism — business leadership exposure), OCR, and process re-engineering.
Built enterprise MI dashboards and analytical reporting using Power BI, SQL, and Python, improving decision-support turnaround times by over 60%.
Owned end-to-end regulatory, legal, and risk compliance for the business domain, ensuring processes operated within robust QC/QA systems and KPI frameworks, sustaining continuous readiness for SOX, Internal Audit, and PwC external audit engagements.
Led Business Contingency Planning — conducting regular contingency maintenance and testing with contingency sites and teams — and owned Control Monitoring Plans, risk mitigation strategies, and regulatory reporting of losses, near misses, and risk events against organizational thresholds and risk appetite. Maintained strong governance of KYC, AML, and Sanctions compliance, including regular risk-awareness training for teams.
• Directed vendor coordination, workforce hygiene, capacity/demand planning, and forecasting to sustain SLA and TPS commitments.
• Led, coached, and developed Team Leaders and Assistant Managers across large, multi-site teams, embedding Operational Excellence
practices (Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement).
Partnered cross-functionally with Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and HR stakeholders to support platform migrations, operating model changes, and regulatory transitions.
SELECTED TRANSFORMATION PROGRAMS
Oct 2013 – Oct 2014
Canada Mortgage Operations Re-Migration Program Led cross-border re-migration of Canada Mortgage Operations from Bangalore and Malaysia to GSC Hyderabad, managing multi-location stakeholder coordination and governance cadence with minimal service impact.
Feb 2020 – Aug 2020
Canada Mortgage French Process Re-Migration Program Led cross-border, multilingual re-migration of Canada French Mortgage Operations from GSC Krakow, Poland to GSC Hyderabad, ensuring uninterrupted service delivery and compliance adherence.
Sep 2020 – Feb 2021
Mortgage & Loan Booking/Funding (Drawdowns) Automation Program Directed automation of mortgage and loan booking/funding processes, reducing turnaround time from 5 days to 1 day and delivering 4+ FTE efficiency savings.
Mortgage DocPac Follow-Up Process Automation Program Led an automated tracking and follow-up framework across a 4,000+ mortgage application pipeline, reducing turnaround from 180 to 60 days and improving legal-charge tracking accuracy.
Nov 2021 – Apr 2022
raw_sections.awards:
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Star of the Business Leader Award (4x), Circle of Excellence (12x), Team of the Year (6x), and Global Excellence Award recipient.
Named Best Manager by the Global Head of Mortgages–Canada (2019) for administering and streamlining a highly critical, complex process.
Recognized by the Global Head of Operations and Global Head of Lending Services for leadership impact.
Sustained a decade-long track record of governance, stakeholder coordination, and compliant transformation delivery in a highly regulated global banking environment.
